zh.sourceText: 越来越多的学生开始使用在线网课。支持者认为，网课让偏远地区的学生也能听到名师讲课，因此网课应该成为学校日常教学的一部分。反对者则担心孩子盯着屏幕太久会伤害眼睛。

textRefs.conclusion_1: 网课应该成为学校日常教学的一部分
textRefs.reason_1: 网课让偏远地区的学生也能听到名师讲课
textRefs.distractor_screen: 担心孩子盯着屏幕太久会伤害眼睛
textRefs.distractor_background: 越来越多的学生开始使用在线网课

hints: 先找作者最想让你接受的那句话——通常在「因此」「所以」之后
反对者的担心是别人的观点，不是作者的结论
文章开头交代的背景，也不是结论
zh.explanation: 作者要你接受的是「网课应该成为学校日常教学的一部分」（结论），用「偏远地区学生也能听到名师讲课」来支撑（理由）。「担心伤眼睛」是反对者的观点——区分「作者的观点」和「别人（被提及）的观点」，是找结论的第一步。

en.sourceText: More and more students are using online courses. Supporters argue that online courses let students in remote areas hear famous teachers, so online courses should become a regular part of school teaching. Opponents worry that children staring at screens too long may hurt their eyes.

textRefs.conclusion_1: online courses should become a regular part of school teaching
textRefs.reason_1: online courses let students in remote areas hear famous teachers
textRefs.distractor_screen: children staring at screens too long may hurt their eyes
textRefs.distractor_background: More and more students are using online courses

hints: Find the sentence the author most wants you to accept — usually after "so" or "therefore"
The opponents' worry is someone else's view, not the author's conclusion
Background facts at the start are not the conclusion
en.explanation: The author wants you to accept "online courses should become a regular part of school teaching" (conclusion), supported by "students in remote areas can hear famous teachers" (reason). "Hurting eyes" is the opponents' view — telling the author's view from views merely mentioned is the first step to finding a conclusion.
